answer: The oasis register is checked at draw time, ferrous lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 77 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 77 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 368 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
